name: A reported value is interpreted incorrectly because its unit of measurement is not stated
description: A position or size may be expressed in bytes, sectors, clusters or blocks, and the size of a sector or cluster varies between devices and file systems. A reader who assumes the wrong unit derives a different location or size. Interpretation here means determining what a reported number denotes, not evaluative interpretation of findings.

references.relevance_summary_280: Argues that the unit of measurement must be stated with a reported value, with the example of a reported position: '34556 what? Bytes, sectors, blocks?'
